verdict.rationale: LibreChat's core purpose is AI interaction with user data. The RAG API gives context-aware responses grounded in user-uploaded files, the code interpreter and agents with file handling can analyze data, and MCP lets agents reach file systems and business tools to work on external data. Missing for 10: proactive or automatically surfaced insights and suggestions (all evidence is user-prompted chat), dedicated data-analysis or insight workflows beyond generic chat, and independent hands-on corroboration of data-insight quality.
